verdict.rationale: IP India's own pages link "Comprehensive e-Filing Services" as the Apply route for patents, trade marks and designs, with an Apply/Track entry for GIs. The patents e-services rail pairs online filing with status tracking, and the published fee schedule lists amounts by filing mode, consistent with filing being completable online. Missing for 10: explicit first-party description of end-to-end online submission and online fee payment (evidence is mostly navigation labels), and no independent or hands-on corroboration of a completed e-filing.
